observerBoundary: The synthetic Commander profiles are controlled behavioral probes, not claims about human player distributions.

mechanicalAudit.boundary: Player-projected outcome, failure, action-divergence, health/resource and objective traces are mechanical trajectory facts. Separate authority annotations exist only for designer causal audit and are never fed into synthetic player decisions. Neither layer establishes fun, preference, tension or meaning by itself.

semanticAudit.instruction: Inspect exact paired trajectories and selected causal windows. Cite turns and consequences. Prefer contrastive claims over absolute scores.

progressiveInspection.when: pacing, long-range learning, strategy formation or delayed consequence remains material
